    Irreducible binary-biproduct maps between finite string modules #

    This file specializes the generic binary-biproduct irreducibility criterion to literal finite string modules. Morphisms between two nonisomorphic string modules are categorical-radical, so two irreducible boundary maps with a common endpoint assemble to an irreducible map whenever their other endpoints are nonisomorphic.
